name: symcrys-repository
description: Repository of symcrys: the TypeScript package (packages/ts, npm) and the Python package (packages/python, PyPI).

scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/ts/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:ts7: node node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc -p packages/ts/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit
scripts.api:check: api-extractor run -c packages/ts/api/index.api-extractor.json && api-extractor run -c packages/ts/api/magnetic.api-extractor.json && api-extractor run -c packages/ts/api/plane.api-extractor.json
scripts.api:report: api-extractor run --local -c packages/ts/api/index.api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/ts/api/magnetic.api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/ts/api/plane.api-extractor.json
scripts.docs:check: typedoc && node scripts/python-api.mjs --check && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p docs/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p docs/examples/browser/tsconfig.json
